notes.title: My next game FLESH MADE FEAR is now live on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3316350/Flesh_Made_Fear/][b]PLAY THE DEMO HERE[/b][/url]

Hey everyone, 

it's Michael from Tainted Pact Games! 

After years of crafting indie horror experiences like Terror at Oakheart, Suffer the Night, and more, I'm beyond excited to announce the launch of my latest project—Flesh Made Fear!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44852736/8b0318eba3036d957e527245c1b8ae264a7f70c2.png[/img]

This game is a love letter to the PSX-era survival horror games we all know and love. Drawing inspiration from the classic Resident Evil trilogy, you'll step into the boots of a Reaper Intervention Platoon member, sent to take down the deranged Victor "The Dripper" Ripper, whose twisted experiments have transformed a quiet town into a nightmare.

Check out some Gameplay:

[previewyoutube=GkAGqReHXR8;full][/previewyoutube]

And the Trailer (posted by IGNːsteamhappyː) : 

[previewyoutube=1Woh2tJEDCE;full][/previewyoutube]

I need YOUR help to make this game everything it can be! With your support, I’ll be able to:

[list]
[*] Add high-quality cutscenes and voice acting
[*] Expand the world with more levels, monsters, and weapons
[*] Polish the controls and camera systems for a better experience
[*] Create branching narratives for more replayability
[*] Bring the game to current-gen consoles!
[/list]

Check out the Kickstarter now and help bring Flesh Made Fear to life! 🔪💀

👉 [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/taintedpactgames/flesh-made-fear]Support on Kickstarter![/url]

Thank you for all your support!

Michael
